cati.hero_subtitle: Road Safety and Traffic Accidents — Technology solution for its implementation
cati.hero_desc: The CATI Law requires electronic enforcement of traffic violations with certified photographic evidence. Visionaria delivers the complete platform — hardware, software and operation — on new infrastructure or on assets already under our maintenance.
cati.context_title: What does the CATI Law require?
cati.context_desc: Law 21.495 on Road Safety and Traffic Accidents sets a new standard for traffic enforcement in Chile, making technology the core of violation detection and recording. Its phased rollout opens a critical window for municipalities, traffic agencies and highway concessionaires.
points: Mandatory electronic traffic enforcement on concessioned highways and high-congestion urban roads
Automated violation recording with photographic evidence valid before the Local Police Court
Interoperability with the National Violations Registry of the Ministry of Transport (SEMTT)
Phased rollout: communes prioritized by CONASET's road-accident rate index

stats.label: photographic evidence available on the JPL portal

cati.detection_desc: Every event generates a record with image, plate, speed or violation type, timestamp and coordinates — evidence valid for notification and proceedings before the Local Police Court.

violations.title: Speeding
violations.desc: Integrated 60 GHz radar measures instantaneous speed with ±2 km/h accuracy. Photo capture of the vehicle, plate and speed in a single violation record.

violations.title: Red light violation
violations.desc: Linked to the traffic signal controller via RS485/dry contact. The system records the crossing while the signal is red, with vehicle image and synchronized timestamp.

violations.title: Misuse of exclusive lanes
violations.desc: Detects vehicles in bus/metro lanes, emergency lanes or segregated corridors via Specific Lane Management, scheduled or permanent.

violations.title: Wrong-way driving
violations.desc: Automatic Reverse Driving Detection for travel against the permitted direction. Generates an immediate alert and record with image and plate.

violations.title: Vehicle without a visible plate
violations.desc: Identifies vehicles circulating without a plate or with a tampered plate (No-plate Vehicle Capture). High-resolution image recorded as evidence.

violations.title: Flow statistics and classification
violations.desc: Counts by vehicle type (car, motorcycle, truck, bus), average speed and hourly distribution. Data for road planning and compliance assessment.

cati.hardware_desc: Same software architecture, same management platform. The unit is chosen based on road type, number of lanes and operating speed.

tiers.title: Compact Radar + LPR
tiers.subtitle: 4 MP · 60 GHz radar · 2 lanes · up to 160 km/h
tiers.desc: All-in-one solution for intersections, 2-lane avenues and communal access roads. Integrated radar module, no additional civil works, PoE powered. Ideal for municipalities looking to start enforcement with a limited investment.

tiers.title: Premium 4K Radar + LPR
tiers.subtitle: 4K · 60 GHz radar · 3 lanes · up to 120 km/h
tiers.desc: For urban highways, ring roads and high-speed arterials with 3 lanes. 4K resolution (3840×2160) and longer read range for sharp capture at higher speeds. Built for metropolitan or interurban enforcement systems.

cati.hardware_footnote: Both models: ONVIF Profile G/M/S/T · REST API · MQTT · RS485 · I/O alarm · PoE 802.3at · IP67 · 3/5-year warranty
cati.service_desc: Visionaria operates over 300 LPR points in the Santiago Metropolitan Region. That installed infrastructure is the foundation for rolling out CATI enforcement without starting from scratch.

service_modes.title: Upgrade on existing infrastructure
service_modes.desc: If you already operate LPR cameras under a maintenance contract with Visionaria, we add enforcement capabilities on top of the installed network: firmware updates, integration with traffic signal controllers and activation of violation-detection modules.

service_modes.title: New sites · Concession model
service_modes.desc: Visionaria finances, installs and operates the equipment. The municipality or public agency receives a fully working system and violation reports with no upfront cost. The recovery model is structured on the processed violation records.

service_modes.title: Enforcement platform as a service
service_modes.desc: Violation records generated by the system feed directly into the municipality's or SEMTT's violation-management platform. Reports, photographic evidence and flow data available via API and web portal.

cati.integration_desc: The CATI module integrates on top of Visionaria's LPR/ANPR platform. Violation records share the same database as SEBV alerts and SITIA events — the operator manages everything from a single console.
integration_list: Violation image + plate + speed in a single ticket
Automatic export in the format required by SEMTT
Checkpoint monitoring dashboard with real-time compliance rate
Automatic reports by segment, time window and violation type
Photographic evidence stored with a cryptographic hash for legal validity

flow_steps.title: Capture
flow_steps.desc: Radar detects speed · camera records a high-resolution image with the plate

flow_steps.title: Recognition
flow_steps.desc: OCR engine identifies the plate in <500 ms · associated vehicle attributes

flow_steps.title: Validation
flow_steps.desc: System checks against configured thresholds (speed, lane, signal)

flow_steps.title: Recording
flow_steps.desc: Ticket generated with evidence, hash and metadata · stored locally and on the central platform

flow_steps.title: Notification
flow_steps.desc: Alert to the operator · export to the municipal or SEMTT violation-management system

cadPsim.hero_subtitle: Integrated citizen protection, at regional scale
cadPsim.hero_desc: We unify an entire territory's security resources — video surveillance, alarms, access control, emergency telephony and more — into a single platform that coordinates operations and shortens response times.
cadPsim.manifesto_quote: Seeing is not the same as responding.
cadPsim.manifesto_desc: A wall of monitors observes, records and deters, but it doesn't decide who acts, how, or leave a trace of what happened. A video surveillance system is not, on its own, a dispatch platform (CAD); and a CAD platform doesn't replace cameras either. They are distinct, complementary pieces.
cadPsim.compare_see_desc: Observes, records and deters; provides evidence. But it doesn't coordinate the response or manage the case.
cadPsim.compare_act_desc: Integrates information, decides and dispatches resources, and leaves a complete trace of every incident.
cadPsim.manifesto_footer: They aren't the same thing — they reinforce each other.
cadPsim.order_desc: That's why we start with operations and case management. Technology comes after — to strengthen it, not replace it.

order_steps.title: Know how to act
order_steps.desc: Clear protocols for every type of situation.

order_steps.title: Coordinate and interact
order_steps.desc: Agencies operating together, not in silos.

order_steps.title: Manage every case
order_steps.desc: Logging, tracking and closing every incident.

order_steps.title: Add technology
order_steps.desc: Cameras, sensors and analytics in service of that operation.

cadPsim.solution_title: A single platform for the entire region
cadPsim.solution_desc1: The platform combines two complementary layers. An integration layer (PSIM) brings distributed security systems — cameras, analytics, alarms, access control and sensors — into a single view, correlates events and delivers situational awareness. An assisted-dispatch layer (CAD) manages the full incident lifecycle: intake, classification, geolocation, resource dispatch and traceability.
cadPsim.solution_desc2: Everything is deployed on a hub-and-spoke architecture: a central, regional-scale node concentrates information and coordination, while each municipality operates its own independent local access node. The result is a uniform protection standard across the whole territory, without duplicating investments.

solution_highlights.s: One standard across the whole territory

cadPsim.arch_footer: Each municipality has its own independent municipal access point with operational autonomy within the regional network.

lpr.hero_subtitle: Automatic license plate reading with institutional integration
lpr.hero_desc: Real-time vehicle recognition, connected to the Carabineros vehicle-search database (SEBV) and the Ministry of the Interior's investigation platform (SITIA) — in under half a second per read.
lpr.cati_subtitle: Speeding · Red light · Exclusive lanes · Wrong-way driving
lpr.cati_desc: The CATI Law requires automated enforcement with certified photographic evidence. We activate these capabilities on existing LPR infrastructure or with new sites — without municipalities and agencies having to start from scratch.
lpr.cati_box_desc: Urban roads (2 lanes, 160 km/h) or expressways (3 lanes, 4K)
lpr.case_desc1: The largest license-plate reading project in Chile: 303 LPR cameras deployed at strategic points across the 23 municipalities of Greater Santiago, operated from the Metropolitan Dispatch Center with direct integration to the Carabineros SEBV and Undersecretariat for Crime Prevention SITIA platforms.
lpr.case_desc2: Every read is checked against both databases in under 500 ms. A match triggers an immediate alert to the operator, opens an incident in the CAD, and notifies the nearest police station with the vehicle's image and travel route.
lpr.integrations_desc: Visionaria's LPR platform operates within Chile's public safety ecosystem, not as an isolated silo.

integrations.name: SEBV — Carabineros de Chile
integrations.desc: Real-time integration with Carabineros' national registry of stolen vehicles. Every read is automatically checked: if the vehicle is under active search, the system generates an immediate alert and opens an incident in the CAD.

integrations.name: SITIA — Undersecretariat for Crime Prevention
integrations.full: Information and Technology System for Investigation and Action
integrations.desc: The LPR system feeds and queries the Ministry of the Interior's SITIA platform, contributing pass records as evidence for criminal investigations and regional crime-pattern analysis.

integrations.name: Regional CAD / PSIM
integrations.desc: Every blacklist match automatically opens an incident in the CAD platform. The operator receives the vehicle's image, owner data (if available) and a suggested response protocol.

lpr.arch_footer: The entire flow happens in under 500 ms. The alert reaches the operator before the vehicle leaves the camera's frame.

capabilities.title: Real-time recognition
capabilities.desc: Automatic plate reading for moving or stationary vehicles, at speeds up to 150 km/h, in day and night conditions, rain and backlight.

capabilities.title: List and alert management
capabilities.desc: Blacklists (stolen, suspended, actively-searched vehicles) and whitelists (authorized access). Instant alert to the operator on any match.

capabilities.desc: Direct connection to institutional databases — including Carabineros records and Ministry of the Interior platforms — via secure protocols and formal agreements.

capabilities.desc: Traffic-flow statistics by checkpoint, time window and road type. Actionable data for traffic management and patrol planning.

capabilities.title: Vehicle access control
capabilities.desc: Automatic barrier or gate opening for an authorized plate. Entry and exit logging for parking lots, industrial sites and municipal access points.

lpr.specs_desc: The values shown correspond to standard installation conditions. Every project includes an on-site technical survey to determine the optimal configuration based on traffic volume, lighting and road type.

specs.value: IP67 or higher in harsh environments

regulatory.title: Law 21.719 — Personal data
regulatory.desc: A plate links to its owner. The system operates under lawful data processing, with a declared purpose, query logging and access restricted to authorized personnel.

regulatory.title: Inter-institutional agreements
regulatory.desc: Integration with Carabineros and SPD databases requires a prior formal agreement. Visionaria supports the documentary and technical management of the agreement as part of the project.

regulatory.title: Defined retention period
regulatory.desc: LPR image storage is sized and capped at the maximum period allowed by regulation, with an automatic deletion policy once the period expires.

use_cases.title: Municipal surveillance
use_cases.desc: Gantries at communal access points with automatic alerts to Carabineros for wanted vehicles.

use_cases.title: Criminal investigation
use_cases.desc: Reconstructing a vehicle of interest's routes from its pass history across multiple checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Industrial access control
use_cases.desc: Automatic entry for authorized vehicles at plants, ports and high-security facilities.

use_cases.title: Road safety and statistics
use_cases.desc: Counting, classification and speed of vehicle flow for traffic authorities.

use_cases.title: High-criticality zones
use_cases.desc: Surveillance with thermal cameras and recognition on critical routes, border zones and strategic infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Parking lots and access points
use_cases.desc: Access-list management for residential complexes, hospitals, universities and corporate buildings.

lpr.implementation_title: What makes the difference on the ground

implementation_notes.title: Mandatory site survey
implementation_notes.desc: Camera positioning and angle are critical to the recognition rate. We always carry out an on-site survey before sizing the project.

implementation_notes.title: Institutional integration managed from day one
implementation_notes.desc: Connecting to SEBV and SITIA requires a formal agreement. We support inter-institutional coordination as part of the process, not as a later stage.

implementation_notes.title: Network infrastructure assessed in detail
implementation_notes.desc: Every checkpoint requires connectivity, latency and redundancy analysis to guarantee the committed response time.

implementation_notes.title: Storage sizing
implementation_notes.desc: LPR images grow fast. We calculate the real volume before defining the storage infrastructure, taking applicable retention regulations into account.

lpr.final_cta_title: Does your municipality or institution need vehicle control?
lpr.final_cta_desc: We advise you on system design, institutional agreements and technical sizing — at no cost.

dafr.hero_desc: The DAFR (Drone as First Responder) concept redefines urban security. Before any patrol reaches the scene of an incident, an autonomous drone is already streaming live video from the exact location of the alarm.
dafr.video_title: See how the DAFR system works
dafr.video_desc: From the alarm to live video in under 90 seconds

steps.label: ALARM
steps.desc: A sensor, camera or panic button triggers the alert in the system.

steps.label: DISPATCH
steps.desc: The Drone Tactical Command Center receives the alarm and orders the automatic takeoff of the nearest drone.

steps.label: TAKEOFF
steps.desc: The drone leaves the DJI Dock station and navigates autonomously to the event location.

steps.label: LIVE VIDEO
steps.desc: The drone arrives and streams Full HD live video to the command center.

steps.label: DECISION
steps.desc: The operator assesses the situation and dispatches the ground response with real information.

features.title: Response in under 90 seconds
features.desc: From the alarm trigger to the drone being over the incident location, response time is under 90 seconds — outpacing any ground patrol.

features.title: Live video to the command center
features.desc: Real-time Full HD streaming to the operator. The response team sees the incident before arriving, improving decision-making and personnel safety.

features.title: Integrated automatic dispatch
features.desc: The Drone Tactical Command Center (CTD) receives the alarm and dispatches the drone automatically, with no human intervention. Compatible with Genetec, Milestone and police dispatch systems.

features.title: Autonomous 24/7 operation
features.desc: DJI Dock station with automatic recharging. The drone returns, recharges and is ready for the next event with no on-site operator required.

why_bullets: Reaches the incident location in under 90 seconds
The operator assesses the situation before sending ground resources
Reduces false alarms — personnel are only dispatched once the drone confirms the incident
24/7 aerial coverage with no risk to security personnel
Native integration with Genetec Security Center and dispatch platforms
Compatible with Carabineros and municipal communication systems
dafr.dji_desc: Expand operational capabilities to fit the needs of each deployment

accessories.title: D-RTK 3 Fixed Relay Version
accessories.desc: Improves the range and quality of RTK signal transmission in complex urban environments.

accessories.title: AS1 Real-Time Speaker
accessories.desc: Broadcast range of up to 300 meters. Enables direct communication from the drone to the incident area.

accessories.title: AL1 Spotlight with Stabilized Tracking
accessories.desc: Powerful illumination at 100 meters with automatic target tracking.

accessories.title: RC Plus 2 Enterprise
accessories.desc: Professional remote control for manual flight of the M4D/M4TD with a high-visibility integrated screen.

accessories.title: Obstacle Detection Module
accessories.desc: Ensures operational safety in environments with obstacles, avoiding collisions during autonomous flight.

accessories.title: Vehicle Mounting Kit
accessories.desc: Ready for mobile deployment. Anti-vibration design and automatic RTK calibration while in motion.

dafr.hardware_title: DJI Dock 3 — Ready for any challenge
dafr.hardware_desc: Autonomous deployment station with built-in FlightHub2 intelligence, EU C6 certification and operation in extreme conditions.

deployments.title: Ready for vehicle deployment
deployments.desc: Anti-vibration design ensures the Dock's reliability. Cloud-based RTK calibration and tilt-angle detection optimize mobile operation and safety.

deployments.title: Simple RTK setup with D-RTK3
deployments.desc: Pairing with D-RTK 3 improves RTK signal acquisition, overcoming deployment limitations in urban environments (placing the Dock 3 near buildings and D-RTK 3 on rooftops).

deployments.title: Improved RTK signal performance
deployments.desc: External RTK module with 2 dB increased signal reception capability, enabling faster and more reliable RTK convergence.

deployments.title: Precise landing techniques
deployments.desc: A combination of SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping) and marker recognition ensures precise landing even in challenging deployment environments.

dafr.flighthub_desc: The DJI Dock 3 with FlightHub2 is smarter than ever. It detects, tracks and acts autonomously in real time.

flighthub_features.title: Real-time AI detection
flighthub_features.desc: Recognition of people, vehicles and vessels with configurable alert thresholds.

flighthub_features.title: Smart tracking
flighthub_features.desc: The drone automatically follows moving targets with no operator intervention.

flighthub_features.title: Change detection
flighthub_features.desc: Compares images from recurring routes and identifies anomalies or changes in the environment.

flighthub_features.title: Automated routes with recognition
flighthub_features.desc: Smart recognition at waypoints: detects, alerts and captures data upon finding a target. Actions: photo, video and hover.

dafr.privacy_title: How does the system protect your data?

privacy_regions.title: AWS server based in the US
privacy_regions.desc: DJI uses Amazon AWS as its cloud services provider, recognized for its security qualifications and high reliability. AWS holds ISO 27001/27017/27018 certifications.

privacy_regions.title: AWS server based in the EU
privacy_regions.desc: DJI is deploying FlightHub 2 on Amazon AWS Frankfurt, Germany. All EU user data stays within European territory, in compliance with GDPR.

dafr.final_cta_title: Is your municipality ready for DAFR?
dafr.final_cta_desc: Our team designs a tailored solution, from station placement to integration with your existing command center.
dafr.case_eyebrow: Want to see a real case?

ipVideo.hero_desc: Cameras stopped being just a visual record. Today they're smart sensors that detect behavior, recognize patterns and anticipate incidents before they escalate — integrated with world-class VMS platforms and your operation's full IoT ecosystem.
ipVideo.analytics_desc: AI engines embedded on-camera (edge) or on-server process every scene in real time, generating actionable alerts instead of hours of unreviewed footage.

analytics_features.title: Behavior detection
analytics_features.desc: Identifies loitering, sudden crowding, falls, fights or abandoned objects, triggering automatic alerts to the monitoring center.

analytics_features.title: Pattern recognition
analytics_features.desc: Learns the normal flow of people and vehicles in a space to detect deviations and anomalies from typical behavior.

analytics_features.title: Object classification
analytics_features.desc: Distinguishes people, vehicles, animals and objects with precision, drastically cutting false alarms from leaves, shadows or insects.

analytics_features.title: Counting & occupancy
analytics_features.desc: Measures foot and vehicle traffic in real time for occupancy management, traffic analysis and data-driven urban planning.

analytics_features.title: Perimeter intrusion
analytics_features.desc: Virtual lines and zones that trigger immediate alerts on unauthorized crossings, even in low-light conditions.

analytics_features.title: AI forensic search
analytics_features.desc: Finds a specific event in minutes among thousands of hours of footage, filtering by attributes like clothing color or vehicle type.

specs.label: Recording retention
specs.value: Configurable — minimum 30 days under Chile's public CCTV regulations

ipVideo.agnostic_title: The solution first, the brand second
ipVideo.agnostic_desc: We're not tied to a single manufacturer. We integrate and are certified partners of the world's leading video surveillance and VMS vendors — choosing on every project the equipment that best solves the client's specific problem, not the one that's most convenient for us to sell.
ipVideo.agnostic_note: This independence lets us compare objectively, avoid vendor lock-in, and protect our clients' long-term investment.
ipVideo.iot_title: One panel for all your sensors
ipVideo.iot_desc: The modern VMS no longer just manages cameras: it becomes the central console for your entire security IoT ecosystem — environmental sensors, access control, gunshot detection, panic buttons, license plate reading and video analytics, all correlated on a single timeline and displayed on the control center's VideoWall.

iot_features.title: Event correlation
iot_features.desc: A door-open sensor plus a camera detecting motion at the same instant generates one prioritized alert, not two isolated events.

iot_features.title: Sensors for every environment
iot_features.desc: WiFi/Zigbee indoors, 4G LTE/NB-IoT in urban outdoor settings, and LoRaWAN or satellite in remote areas — each sensor using the protocol that fits its location.

iot_features.title: Open interoperability
iot_features.desc: Standard protocols (ONVIF, MQTT, CoAP, REST APIs) let you add new devices without replacing existing infrastructure.

iot_features.title: Unified VideoWall visualization
iot_features.desc: Cameras, CAD/PSIM maps and IoT dashboards share the same control center video wall, with one-click layout changes per operational scenario.

ipVideo.why_title: Video surveillance that adapts to your operation
why_bullets: Custom-tailored architecture: the right camera for every point, not a generic catalog.
AI analytics calibrated to the site's real context, reducing false alarms.
Native integration with CAD/PSIM, LPR and DAFR within the same Visionaria ecosystem.
Multi-brand technical support — a single provider for your entire video infrastructure.
ipVideo.final_cta_title: Let's talk about your video surveillance project
ipVideo.final_cta_desc: We analyze your operation and propose the camera architecture, analytics and IoT integration that best fits — with no ties to a single brand.
